summary: Hardened the existing Rust scaffold into a typed audio source-of-truth domain and versioned SQLite WAL ledger with atomic no-silent-gap sequence enforcement.
implemented: serializable Session, AudioChannel, AudioChunk, Gap, CaptureState, DeviceState, and RecoveryState entities
per-channel source kind, native format, channel mask, monotonic sequence, QPC, and device-position metadata
non-blocking capture handoff plus raw spool and durable ledger ports
idempotent ordered SQLite migrations with WAL, foreign keys, lifecycle history, and sequence indexes
transactional chunk commits that reject regression and unexplained forward sequence jumps
explicit known and unknown gap extents queryable for the eventual hardware gate
Rust format, clippy, and tests integrated into the repository verification gate
